sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Distribution of Excess Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors and Resistors

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law, French civil law, and customary law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu is a WTO Member and benefits from MFN-based trade access; no comprehensive standalone bilateral investment treaty confirmed in force.
PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations) ratified; provides a regional trade and investment framework.
Various Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) concluded in connection with OECD Global Forum commitments; no full Double Taxation Agreements are in force.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 43 of 2017 (as amended); International Companies Act [CAP 222] (as amended, including beneficial ownership registration provisions); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 38 of 2012; United Nations (Financial Prohibitions, Arms Embargoes and Sanctions) Act [CAP 221] (as amended); VFSC AML/CFT Regulatory Directions and Practice Notes.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each proposed director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public / Commissioner of Oaths in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Apostille not applicable because Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing for each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry in the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of corporate shareholder authorizing incorporation of the Vanuatu International Company and appointing first directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified bank reference letter for each shareholder/UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization for bank-issued notarial certification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential or business address (utility bill or bank statement) for each proposed director, shareholder and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, government revenue office, or financial institution

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU and relevant in-force domestic targeted financial sanctions lists. PEP screening is mandatory for foreign and domestic politically exposed persons, their family members and close associates, triggering enhanced due diligence. Continuous transaction monitoring and suspicious transaction reporting to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit is required under the AML/CFT Act and VFSC Directions.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry – Company Name Search and Reservation: https://eregistry.vfsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be entered in Latin script using English or French spelling conventions. Non-Latin names, including Chinese-character names, are not accepted in the official register unless transliterated into Latin script. The name must be distinguishable from existing reserved or registered names and must not be obscene, contrary to law, or reasonably likely to mislead.

stage_1.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written appeal with VFSC’s Companies Section within 14 days of the rejection notice, quoting the name-search reference and setting out grounds for reconsideration. VFSC shall determine the appeal within 10 business days. If the appeal is dismissed, judicial review may be sought before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within the applicable administrative-review limitation period. Name reservations may be renewed on application and payment of the prevailing reservation fee before expiry.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (Cap. 222), as amended; key sections: s.4 (incorporation), s.11 (registered office), s.30 (directors), s.39 (company secretary), Schedule 1 (Memorandum and Articles).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company) and Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement and no escrow account is required. The authorized share capital is chosen by the incorporator and set out in the Memorandum and Articles; the first share may be issued at par value without capital deposit.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers to the Memorandum and Articles be appointed as the first directors, effective immediately. RESOLVED that the registered office be established at the registered agent's office in Port Vila, Vanuatu. RESOLVED that the Company adopt the submitted Memorandum and Articles as its constitution. RESOLVED that one ordinary share be issued to the sole subscriber at par value. RESOLVED that the company secretary be appointed. RESOLVED that the directors be authorized to open bank accounts, engage qualified accountants, and execute all documents to begin passive electronic inventory distribution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage Licensed Registered Agent and Reserve Company Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent in Vanuatu supervised by the VFSC Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a locally licensed registered agent to conduct a name availability search against the International Companies Register and submit a name reservation request to the VFSC. Provide notarised identity documents and a source-of-funds confirmation. The agent will issue an engagement memorandum and confirm the reserved name.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (one primary and three alternatives)
Notarised passport copy of the incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused on grounds of similarity, file a fresh reservation with alternative names or apply to the VFSC Registry for an administrative review of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files Form 1 together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association, consents of the initial directors and secretary, and proof of the registered agent's office. The filing is made electronically or in paper form at the VFSC counter, and the prescribed government fee is paid. Documents executed abroad must be notarised and, if required, apostilled.
required_dossiers: Registered office consent from the licensed agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, submit the requested clarifications or amended documents to the Registry within 14 business days. If rejected, correct the cited defects and re-file with a fresh application fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the VFSC registers the company and issues the Certificate of Incorporation with a unique company number and incorporation date. The registered agent retrieves the certificate and supplies a certified copy to the directors. Verify that the company name, registered office, and date are correctly recorded.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles
VFSC company extract or register entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical or legal errors, file a rectification application with a statutory declaration and supporting evidence; no additional government fee is normally levied for clerical corrections.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Hold First Board Resolution and Commence Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The directors execute the pro-forma first board resolution adopting the registered office, approving the share allotment, and appointing officers. The corporate registers are opened, and the directors may then proceed to open corporate bank accounts and execute contracts for the passive electronic inventory trading activity.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an officer appointment is procedurally defective, pass a new board resolution and file a revised consent with the VFSC. If bank acceptance is queried, provide enhanced due diligence materials including a business plan and source-of-wealth evidence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial license is mandated for the distribution of passive electronic components. If physical warehousing is established, the Port Vila Municipality may require a Municipal Business Licence; manufacturing activity is outside the scope.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No specific operating license applies to passive electronic inventory distribution; optionally, a Municipal Business Licence for a general trading and warehousing operation.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – the activity comprises low-impact import, storage, and distribution of multilayer ceramic capacitors and resistors; no EIA report or registration is triggered under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater or VOC point-source emissions thresholds are triggered. Packaging waste must be managed under the Waste Management Act; if any adhesive or flux is stored, VOC persistent concentration must remain below 2 mg/m³ over the warehouse boundary.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Fire Services is required for any warehouse exceeding the internal floor-area threshold. Structural load inspections must confirm racking capacity for stored electronic inventories, and occupational clearance must verify ESD-safe flooring, adequate ventilation, and emergency egress per the National Building Code.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu; customs/revenue filings via the national ASYCUDA World single-window portal; exempt International Company registration via Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: No TIN or VAT ID is obtainable or required for an offshore International Company (IC). The IC is automatically exempt from all Vanuatu taxes under s.134 of the International Companies Act [Cap.222] and is statutorily prohibited from domestic taxable activity under s.135; the VFSC-issued registration certificate ('IC-xxxxx') is the sole tax-relevant identifier. A VAT registration number is issued only to domestic traders exceeding VUV 2,000,000 turnover; such registration is legally unavailable to an exempt IC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (statutorily exempt non-resident offshore company; Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax or stamp duty, so entity-level taxation is nil and the s.134 exemption applies automatically while the IC avoids local resident trading).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None tax-related. Vanuatu has no income tax, so no check-the-box, hybrid-mismatch, CFC or group election exists. The only corporate election is conversion of an IC into a domestic company under the Companies Act [Cap.191]; conversion forfeits the s.134 exempt status and makes the entity subject to VAT, business licence fees and customs duties.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 11 of 1998, as amended; destination-based tax on taxable supplies made in Vanuatu and on imports.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 2,000,000 annual taxable turnover (VAT Act registration threshold); inapplicable to an exempt offshore IC, which has no domestic VAT nexus and cannot register.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time electronic invoicing, fiscal API clearance or digital stamping mandate exists. VAT is evidenced by prescribed paper/PDF tax invoices, while customs declarations must be submitted electronically through ASYCUDA World.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods are zero-rated under the VAT Act where goods are physically removed from Vanuatu within 28 days of supply and the supplier retains export evidence. A pure offshore IC distributing passive electronic components dropshipped from foreign principals to foreign buyers never enters the Vanuatu VAT net, so no output VAT, input credit or export refund mechanics arise. Vanuatu has no exchange controls; the 180-day inward remittance window is the bank/audit substantiation benchmark.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration filed in ASYCUDA World (HS 8532 for ceramic capacitors and HS 8533 for fixed resistors)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export from Vanuatu within the 28-day statutory window
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 credit advice evidencing receipt of foreign-currency proceeds within the 180-day window
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No income-tax clawback exists. Enforcement risks: (i) false VAT zero-rating/refund claims attract civil penalty of up to 200% of tax evaded plus interest and possible imprisonment; (ii) false customs export declarations trigger seizure and penalty assessments; (iii) an IC that trades with Vanuatu residents or in Vatu forfeits s.134 exemption and is liable to VFSC fines and retrospective VAT/import assessments on domestic-connected supplies.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act, operating in conjunction with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for licensing and corporate compliance matters.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is generally freely convertible for legitimate current account transactions including trade settlements, service payments, and dividend or profit remittances, subject to prevailing anti-money laundering (AML) documentation. Capital account transactions, including inbound equity injections, shareholder loans, and repo-style liquidity arrangements, are not subject to restrictive prior central bank approval for International Companies, but local commercial banks will independently apply source-of-funds verification and foreign investment due diligence. There are no exchange-controlled queues, surrender requirements, or differentiated current/offshore market rates; resident and non-resident accounts may be maintained in VUV or major foreign currencies such as USD, AUD, EUR, and GBP.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu does not impose any statutory surrender timeline or mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds. A VU International Company (IC) is permitted to retain export receipts in foreign currency accounts domestically or offshore without force-sale conversion to VUV. For statistical and balance-of-payments reporting, commercial banks must submit transaction-level data to the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu within their regular reporting cycle; no export certificate or central bank permit is required solely for retention or deployment of export receivables.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account for cross-border trade collections and supplier disbursements; Capital Escrow Account for inbound shareholder equity and subordinated loan warehousing.
Operational Account with dedicated USD trading desk and commercial letter of credit processing; Capital Escrow Account for regulated inbound investment funding.
Operational Account for treasury settlement and liquidity concentration; secondary Capital Escrow Account if counterparty bank diversification is required.
Domestic Operational Account for VUV clearing and local expenses; not preferred for cross-border component trade because of narrower correspondent banking network.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium viability for offshore digital electronic-money institutions (EMIs). VFSC does not recognize a generic EMI licence, and the Financial Dealers Licensing Act restricts unauthorized electronic money issuance; however, a VU International Company may use a VFSC-licensed remittance dealer or a fully licensed overseas EMI for auxiliary receivable collection in USD/AUD, provided the EMI does not become the primary settlement bank for trade disbursements. Major tier-1 commercial banks in Vanuatu remain the only acceptable clearing counterparties for documentary credits, structured trade finance, and escrow-capital injection.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical director presence is not an absolute statutory mandate for a VU International Company, but tier-1 banks typically require at least one director or a formal mandatee with a power of attorney to attend an in-person or video-verified interview. For non-resident principals controlling the IC through trust or corporate chains, in-branch interview at ANZ or BSP Port Vila is commonly required unless the bank accepts a pre-approved correspondent-bank KYC package. Remote opening is possible only where the ultimate beneficial owner passes sanctions screening, source-of-wealth interrogation, and the bank's internal video-identification protocols.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Circular or high-velocity passive electronic inventory transactions involving linear purchase and resale of multilayer ceramic capacitors and resistors with thin gross margins.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full supply-chain transaction pack: signed master distribution agreement, ISIC 4652 purchase orders, supplier proforma invoices, shipping documents (airway bill or bill of lading), inspection certificates, freight insurance, and warehouse receipt evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity in beneficial ownership due to multiple layers of nominee shareholders, trustee arrangements, or non-resident corporate shareholders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current registered shareholder register, corporate organisational chart, trust deed or declaration of trust, VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing, notarised passport copies, and source-of-wealth statement backed by audited financials or bank references.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction counterparties located in jurisdictions perceived as high risk for sanctions, money laundering, or trade-based financial crime.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Counterparty onboarding documentation: licences, board resolution, shareholder register, ownership chain, UN and OFAC sanctions screening, Export Control and Customs classification certificates for electronic components, and enhanced due diligence questionnaire completed by the counterparty.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between the IC's small paid-up capital and high-value electronic inventory trade flows, triggering suspicion of straw-man corporate shell activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Purpose and projected transaction statement, board resolution authorising cross-border distribution operations, capital contribution records, shareholder loan agreements, audited or management financial statements, existing purchase orders from original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and electronic manufacturing services (EMS) providers, and bank reference from any historical trading bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injection shall be routed as a SWIFT MT103 or MT202 from the overseas shareholder's bank directly into the VU IC's Capital Escrow Account at a tier-1 Vanuatu commercial bank. The wire must clearly state the economic purpose code as either 'Direct Investment Equity Capital' or 'Intercompany/Shareholder Subordinated Loan'; the receiving bank will apply value-dated funds verification and request a board resolution, shareholder loan deed, VFSC corporate extract, and know-your-customer confirmation for the ultimate funding source. Funds must remain in the escrow account and may be funneled into the Operational Account only after compliance sign-off; for capital above customary thresholds, the bank may require evidence of Foreign Investment Registration if the IC is undertaking branch-like physical activity, though a purely passive distribution IC without a domestic physical trade presence is generally exempt under Vanuatu International Companies legislation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements for passive electronic inventory purchases will be cleared predominantly through SWIFT MT103 direct remittances for open-account supplier payments and through documentary commercial letters of credit (sight or usance) issued under ICC UCP 600 for negotiated procurement from OEM/EMS suppliers. USD payments to Chinese, Taiwanese, Korean, and North American component manufacturers will route via the bank's New York correspondent (Fedwire/CHIPS); EUR-denominated obligations will clear via SEPA through the bank's European correspondent; and Australian-dollar payments will clear via the bank's Australian branch network or an AUSTRAC-regulated correspondent. For VUV-denominated local expenses, settlement occurs through RBV's interbank clearing platform. The bank's trade finance desk will require underlying purchase orders, supplier invoices, and logistics proof before executing each disbursement; prohibited strings include payments to sanctioned entities, cash-sweep transfers, and invoices not clearly tied to ISIC 4652 component transactions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore OTC Vanuatu vatu (VUV) forward contracts with RBV-licensed commercial banks, limited to bona fide trade and balance-sheet exposure in passive electronic component distribution.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in USD/VUV or AUD/VUV using the RBV indicative mid-rate, entered through reputable global banks for hedging forecasted cash flows where onshore forward liquidity is insufficient.

Cross-currency swaps (VUV against USD, AUD, or EUR) executed between the VU IC and a licensed commercial bank for period-end treasury netting, subject to underlying exposure documentation and bank credit approval.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee and Registered Agent Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of incorporation; renewal payment must be completed before the end of the anniversary month through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% surcharge imposed if the annual fee remains unpaid after 30 days; continued non-payment for 6 months triggers administrative strike-off from the International Companies Register and dissolution of the legal entity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually not later than the last business day of the month in which the anniversary of incorporation falls
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure of the registered agent to certify compliance may place the company in default status; habitual default may result in a monetary penalty of up to USD 500 and administrative dissolution after 90 days

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit threshold applies to a Vanuatu International Company; mandatory audit is not triggered solely by turnover, assets, or employee count, but may be required by a VFSC license condition, shareholder resolution, or if the company holds prescribed financial services activities
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap 222); no mandatory application of IFRS or Vanuatu local GAAP; books and records must be retained sufficient to explain material transactions, cash flows, and true financial position; statements may be prepared under any reasonably recognized accounting framework

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu does not maintain a public UBO register; the licensed registered agent must obtain an annual confirmation from each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner verifying identity and any share transfers during the year. Any transfer must be entered in the Register of Members before the annual confirmation is signed; the agent must retain this confirmation for VFSC inspection but no public state filing is required

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit required; voluntary certified audit range USD 2,500 - 6,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory tax exemption for International Companies under the International Companies Act 1992 [Cap. 222]: no corporate income tax, no dividend withholding tax, no capital gains tax, no stamp duty on share transfers, and no exchange control. The only recurring cost is the annual VFSC licence fee (approximately US$250-US$500 depending on the authorised capital band).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The substituted filing obligation is the Annual Declaration and Licence Fee Return lodged with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the VFSC Online Registry and the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the last day of the month of the anniversary of incorporation, being the same date on which the annual licence fee falls due.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name and International Companies Registry number of the IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the exact registered legal name; no trading name is recognised unless separately recorded with the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office in Vanuatu, maintained by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The address must be an approved registered-agent address in Port Vila or Luganville; a post-office box or virtual-only address is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number and contact details of the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent holds a VFSC licence and must be engaged by the non-resident beneficial owner under a written agency agreement; the agent is the official point of service in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total authorised share capital expressed in US Dollars; determines the annual licence fee band.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum paid-up capital is required; 100% non-resident ownership is permitted and shares may be held by corporate nominees subject to the beneficial ownership register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, addresses and shareholdings of all directors and shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No Vanuatu residency requirement applies to directors or shareholders; natural persons or corporate entities resident anywhere outside Vanuatu may hold all offices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sworn declaration that the IC has not traded with Vanuatu residents, has not owned or leased Vanuatu real property, and has not undertaken banking, insurance or trust business without a licence.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A false declaration exposes the non-resident beneficial owner and the directors to deregistration, fines and criminal liability; the declaration is the core condition of tax-exempt status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 7 - AML/CFT and Beneficial Ownership Confirmation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the IC's beneficial ownership register is current and that customer due diligence files are held by the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must hold a certified passport copy, proof of address and source-of-funds documentation for each ultimate beneficial owner; failure to maintain these records is an independent regulatory breach.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or late payment triggers an automatic surcharge of 10% of the annual licence fee. Continued default results in VFSC written notice and, after two consecutive annual defaults, strike-off and dissolution of the IC. Directors and shareholders lose the statutory limited-liability shield for debts incurred after dissolution and may be sued personally by creditors; reinstatement requires payment of arrears, penalties and court or Registry approval.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax. A Vanuatu International Company may distribute profits by dividend, share redemption or capital reduction entirely free of Vanuatu tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has concluded no comprehensive double taxation agreements. No TRC-based withholding relief procedure exists domestically because no withholding tax is imposed. To evidence tax-exempt status to a foreign tax administrator, the non-resident owner should request a Certificate of Tax-Exempt Status or Good Standing Certificate from the VFSC through its licensed registered agent and present it to the counterparty jurisdiction's competent authority.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory rate for royalties and interest: 0%. Treaty rate: not applicable, because Vanuatu maintains no income tax treaty network. Counterparty jurisdictions may nevertheless apply their own withholding, CFC, hybrid-payment or anti-avoidance rules to outbound payments.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing legislation and prescribes no Local File or Master File threshold in any local currency. Multinational groups should nonetheless compile OECD-aligned transfer-pricing documentation (functional analysis and benchmarking appropriate to the passive electronic component distribution function) to defend the intermediary margin in the counterparty jurisdiction and to resist recharacterisation of the IC as a conduit.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not currently operate Economic Substance Regulations equivalent to BVI or Cayman ESR. Statutory substance duties under the International Companies Act are limited to maintaining a registered office and licensed agent, keeping books and records, and filing the annual declaration. Foreign tax authorities may disregard or pierce a 'brass-plate' IC lacking real operational substance when distributing multilayer ceramic capacitors and resistors, particularly where the IC holds no inventory title, maintains no bank account in its own name, employs no staff, and exercises no board authority over the distribution transactions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Carrying on business in Vanuatu, trading with Vanuatu residents, owning or leasing Vanuatu land, or conducting banking, insurance or trust business without a licence, in breach of sections 4 and 11 of the International Companies Act 1992 [Cap. 222].
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imposition of statutory fines on the company and each officer as prescribed by the International Companies Act, forced deregistration and winding-up orders; the offending transaction is void and unenforceable.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Veil-piercing applies: every director and officer who knowingly authorised the prohibited act is jointly and severally liable for the company's debts and losses, subject to criminal fines, disqualification orders and civil restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the annual declaration and to pay the annual VFSC licence fee by the anniversary month, or filing a materially false declaration with the Registry.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic 10% late-payment surcharge; after two consecutive annual defaults the Registry strikes the company off and dissolves it; company assets escheat to the Vanuatu Government subject to liquidation costs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shareholders lose the statutory shield of limited liability for debts and liabilities incurred after dissolution; creditors and the Registrar may bring civil claims directly against them.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Abuse / Foreign Tax Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC solely as a passive booking shell to conceal inventory turnover of capacitors and resistors, divert group profits, and evade income tax in the residence jurisdiction of the ultimate shareholder.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: No direct Vanuatu income-tax sanction exists, but the IC may be recharacterised as a sham by foreign courts, Vanuatu may face countermeasures under the OECD Global Forum and Inclusive Framework, and the VFSC may revoke exempt status for breach of good standing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be named in foreign criminal tax proceedings, subjected to extradition requests, asset-freezing orders and travel bans, and held personally liable under civil conspiracy, fraudulent-trading or dishonest-assistance theories.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing suspicious Swift wire transfers and trade payments without customer due diligence, concealing beneficial ownership, or handling proceeds of crime through the IC's settlement accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offences under the Vanuatu Proceeds of Crime Act and the Financial Dealers Act 2020: fines up to VUV 30,000,000 (approximately US$250,000), imprisonment up to 20 years, confiscation of assets and revocation of the registered agent's licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face imprisonment, travel bans, confiscation orders and long-term prohibition from acting as officers of any Vanuatu company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misrepresentation and Fraud on the Registry
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly submitting false annual declarations, fictitious director or shareholder particulars, or concealing prohibited Vanuatu-resident business from the VFSC and the registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties for false statements under the International Companies Act, immediate cancellation of the IC's registration, and referral for prosecution for fraud under the Vanuatu Penal Code.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for fines and imprisonment; the court may order restitution to defrauded trade creditors, disgorgement of profits and payment of liquidation costs.
